title: first-qa plan next_command points at apply (not re-plan)
summary: plan_first_qa_seed, assess_adoption_readiness, and what_next (first_qa_seed + adoption_session seed phase) set next_command to --apply-first-qa instead of circular --first-qa-plan; seeded/applied still route to feed.
migration_impact: Additive routing only. Agents should execute next_command (apply-first-qa + runner) instead of re-planning from adopt status, what-next, or first-qa dry-run.
agent_notes: On core_ready + first_qa unseeded, adopt status and what-next next_command are apply-first-qa (runner required). Do not loop on plan-only. Parent Epic #1000.
